title: Sales Consultant
description:
As a Sales Consultant in your local store, your product knowledge and natural ability to engage with customers and advise them on Sleep wellness will help them find the right sleep products for their needs, giving them that perfect night's sleep every night, with the help of our unique sleepPRO technology! We'll offer you full training and support to do all this and to understand how we get things done in the right way - we want to set you up for success, so you can hit the ground running.

We want our stores to be a place our teams can be proud of, so you and your team will need to get stuck in to help keep the store looking fresh and keeping your store clean and tidy.

Our customers come in when they're free to shop, so evenings, weekends and bank holidays are our peak trade hours. This is where you'll have the opportunity to experience our fantastic, uncapped commission structure, so it'll be essential for you to be available to work those hours. We understand that you have a life outside beds, so we'll ensure that you get the days back you have worked over the weekend - but, there's also overtime available at times.

What we're dreaming of seeing:

We're looking for Sales Consultants who take pride in great customer service, so you and your customers can rest easy in the knowledge that you're driven to meet your targets in the best way - by giving them what they need for the best night's sleep. This will take a 'can do' attitude, and the ability to adapt your approach to establish their needs and ensure that your service is the mint on the pillow of their shopping experience.

Ideally, you'll have worked in a customer facing role previously and have confident communication skills, being able to spot sales opportunities and be resilient and resourceful when you need to be, daring to try new things to help your store succeed.

The best sleep is when we feel comfortable

This is why we believe it's only right that at bensons for beds you'll be welcome to bring your authentic self to work. Some of us like a sprung mattress, others are all about the memory foam, but at the end of the day we all want to feel comfortable, so we welcome all applications and treat them, and you with respect.

The cool side of the pillow (our benefits):

We know you'll work hard to contribute your store's performance, so as well as your base salary and OTE based on your target, there's no upper limit to what you can earn beyond that. There's also monthly store bonus potential when your store achieves its target! In addition, we offer:
- Up to 50% discount for all bensons colleagues
- Health and Wellbeing: Medicash- cashback options for Health and Wellbeing services, Access to Retail Trust services (guidance and support on retail issues, mental health, wellbeing & financial topics)
- Financial: Group Income Protection - for peace of mind if you're off work long term due to illness,
- Pension scheme - provided by Legal & General
- Leave:Annual leave buy & sell scheme - you can top up your holiday entitlement or sell unused days to suit you, Enhanced maternity and adoption leave
- Your Career: Learning and development programmes to expand your knowledge and skills, access to internal opportunities to progress your career at Bensons for Beds
- Group Life Assurance - 2x annual salary
- Annual leave: 28 days in year 1, rising each year of service

( qualifying periods apply)

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive B2 B

Location: Leeds Free Parking

Salary: £26k starting - rising to £29k quickly

OTE: £55k - £65k uncapped

Info: Fantastic benefits, training, and career growth opportunities.

B2 B Sales Executive - £55k-£65k OTE

Leeds Free Parking

£26,000 starting salary, rising quickly to £29,000

£55,000-£65,000 realistic OTE Uncapped commission

Established top performers earning £65,000+

If you're looking for a career in sales but want better earning potential, excellent training and somewhere you can genuinely progress, this could be a great move.

Our client is an established market leader in business technology solutions providing essential products and services to companies across the UK.

You'll work with both existing and new B2 B customers, receive excellent training and ongoing support from experienced sales leaders, and have a realistic opportunity to earn £55k-£65k with uncapped commission.

Just as importantly, if you're ambitious about your career as well as your earnings, there are genuine opportunities to progress into senior sales, field sales and management.

The Role

As a Sales Executive, you'll speak with existing customers and new business clients about their communication and technology requirements.

You'll be:
- Building relationships with existing B2 B customers and identifying opportunities for renewals, upgrades and additional services.
- Speaking with new business customers and developing new sales opportunities.
- Advising clients on business-critical technology products and solutions.
- Working alongside the field sales team on larger client opportunities.
- Managing your own sales pipeline and working towards clear targets.

You'll be joining an established and professional sales operation with excellent technology, training and experienced leadership around you.

Salary & Commission

You'll start on a £26,000 basic salary, with the opportunity to increase quickly to £29,000, plus an attractive uncapped commission structure.

£55,000-£65,000 OTE is realistic, with established top performers earning £65,000+.

Perform well and there is no ceiling on what you can earn or where this role can take you.

About You

We're open-minded about where you've gained your experience.

B2 B sales experience would be an advantage, but we'll also consider good salespeople from other backgrounds who have the communication skills, attitude and ambition to succeed.

You may currently work in B2 B Sales, Inside Sales, Telesales, Account Management, Business Development, Customer Retention or a similar role.

More importantly, you'll be someone who:
- Enjoys speaking with customers and building relationships.
- Is motivated by achieving results and earning good commission.
- Is confident, ambitious and takes ownership of their performance.
- Enjoys being part of a successful and supportive sales team.
- Wants to develop their skills and progress their career.

You don't need previous experience in technology or communications. You'll receive structured product and sales training, followed by ongoing coaching and support from experienced sales leaders.

Career Progression

This is a business that invests in its people and has a strong culture of developing and promoting from within.

So, if you're looking for somewhere you can increase your earnings now while building a longer-term sales career, there is plenty of opportunity to do both.

What You'll Get
- £26,000 starting salary, rising quickly to £29,000.
- £55,000-£65,000 realistic OTE.
- Uncapped commission with established top performers earning £65,000+.
- Structured product and sales training.
- Ongoing coaching and support from experienced sales leaders.
- Genuine opportunities for internal promotion.
- Career paths into senior sales, field sales and management.
- Excellent company benefits and incentives.
- Regular social events and a strong team culture.
- Free parking at the office
- The stability and backing of an established market-leading business.

When You Apply

We believe recruitment should be straightforward and personal.

Every application to Red Rhino Solutions is read by an experienced recruiter - not an automated screening system.

There are no bots or automated conversations. If we contact you, you'll speak with a real person who knows the company intimately, understands the role and can answer your questions properly.

Interested? Apply today and we'll personally review your application.

Follow us on LinkedIn for more job opportunities.

title: Sales & Account Manager
company: Lucy Walker Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are recruiting for an ambitious, driven and commercially minded Sales & Account Manager who is looking for a career role and the opportunity to progress and flourish.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of an established active client portfolio and to generate approximately £150k of new business annually which is highly achievable looking at the average order value.

If you're motivated by targets, enjoy picking up the phone, creating opportunities and winning new business, this could be the role where you really make your mark.

The more you put in, the more you can get out. For the right person, there is genuine opportunity to develop your responsibilities, progress your career and potentially move into a future management position as the business continues to grow.

The Opportunity

Our client is an established and growing business supplying products and services to secondary schools across the UK and British schools overseas.

The traditional market is well established, but there is significant growth potential across a wider and expanding product range. The business is looking for someone who sees opportunity and who is excited by the challenge of winning new customers and growing existing accounts.

Key Responsibilities:
- Identify and engage decision-makers within prospect organisations to generate new sales opportunities.
- Proactively generate new business through outbound telephone and email activity.
- Manage and grow an established customer portfolio, maximising retention and revenue.
- Work towards agreed turnover, margin and new business targets.
- Develop compelling sales pitches tailored to individual customer requirements.
- Negotiate confidently and convert opportunities into profitable sales.
- Identify opportunities to introduce customers to new and developing products.

Skills & Knowledge
- Proven sales or business development experience
- New business generation and lead conversion
- Ability to engage and influence key decision-makers
- Confident telephone and email sales ability
- Strong negotiation and closing skills
- Target and revenue-focused approach
- Strong relationship-building skills

Key attributes:
- Hungry
- Driven
- Competitive
- Proactive
- Resilient
- Commercially minded
- Ambitious
- Relationship focused

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to respond to every applicant individually. If you have been shortlisted, we will be in touch to discuss your application and the next steps. If you do not hear from us, please assume that on this occasion your application has been unsuccessful.
